decisions.reason: As a low-risk design extension of the core drainage range that remained visible and gained its own page after launch, it likely still offers upside at little option-holding cost.
This product stayed prominently marketed across both years and fits the firm's main technical and architectural positioning, so its value appears sufficiently validated to keep.

The pump-drain concept is newer and more uncertain, especially given the earlier disappearance of a related pump-assisted line, but after only one year the firm would likely keep the option open while monitoring market acceptance.
